name: Find Loaded Module (SA)
help: Find processes that have a specific module loaded
long_help: Searches all running processes to find which ones have a specific module (DLL) loaded. Supports partial matching on both module name and process name. Useful for identifying processes with specific DLLs like amsi.dll or security product DLLs.

arguments.name: modname
arguments.desc: Module name or partial match to search for (e.g., amsi.dll, ntdll)

arguments.name: procname
arguments.desc: Process name filter - only search processes matching this string (empty for all processes)
